| `Toml` | Class | Static entry points for TOML parsing, stringification and the schema factories. Not instantiable. | parse and stringify a toml document, entry point for toml 1.1.0 parsing |
| `TomlArray` | Class | An array value node. Heterogeneous per TOML; may span multiple lines (the span covers brackets, inner newlines and inner comments). | heterogeneous list possibly spanning multiple lines with comments |
| `TomlArrayTableHeader` | Class | A `[[array-of-tables]]` header expression. Span contract as in `TomlKeyValue`. | [[table]] header expression |

| `TomlBoundCodec` | Interface | A domain codec pre-bound to its two directions, returned by `Toml.bind`: the composed `schema` (what `Toml.schema` returns) plus `decode` and `encode` functions derived from it once, so callers need no generic `Schema` machinery at the use site. | |
| `TomlDateTimeLiteral` | Class | A date-time value node wrapping one of the four TOML date-time classes. | wrapping local date, local time, local date-time or offset date-time |
| `TomlDiagnostic` | Class | One structured diagnostic: its `(TomlErrorCode:type)`, a human-readable `message`, and its exact position (`offset`/`length`, plus zero-based `line`/`character`). | one structured toml parse or stringify diagnostic: error code, message, source position |
| `TomlDocument` | Class | A parsed TOML document that never loses a byte: the `source` text, the linear `(TomlExpression:type)` CST whose spans tile the source exactly, and any semantic violations as `TomlDiagnostic` data. | lossless parsed toml document, byte-exact source plus CST and semantic diagnostics, parse a cargo.toml |
| `TomlEdit` | Class | A non-mutating text edit: replace the span `[offset, offset + length)` with `content`. Set `length` to `0` to insert, `content` to `""` to delete. | a non-mutating text edit over a toml document, replace a span |

| `TomlExpression` | Variable + TypeAlias | The union of all expression node types. | union of top-level toml CST node types: key-value, table header, array-table header |
| `TomlFloat` | Class | A float value node, including the special spellings (`inf`, `nan`). | including inf and nan spellings |
| `TomlFormat` | Class | Formatting and modification statics. Not instantiable. | format or modify a toml document by path, apply a structured edit |
| `TomlFormattingOptions` | Class | Options controlling formatting and modification behavior. The only knob is `newline`: for `format` it normalizes every newline outside multi-line strings; for `modify` it overrides the dominant newline inherited by inserted lines. | options controlling toml format and modify newline normalization |
| `TomlInlineEntry` | Class | One `key = value` entry inside an inline table. `keyPath` has more than one element for dotted keys (`{a.b = 1}`). | one key = value entry inside a toml inline table, dotted key path entry |
| `TomlInlineTable` | Class | An inline table value node (`{ k = v, ... }`). May span multiple lines since TOML 1.1 (the span covers braces, inner newlines and inner comments). | { k = v } braces possibly spanning multiple lines since 1.1 |
| `TomlInteger` | Class | An integer value node. Decodes to `number` when the magnitude fits in 2^53 - 1, else `bigint` (TOML integers span the full signed 64-bit range). | decodes to number or bigint for full 64-bit range |
| `TomlKey` | Class | One simple key within a (possibly dotted) key path. | one simple key segment within a possibly dotted toml key path |
| `TomlKeyKind` | Variable + TypeAlias | The union of all key-kind string literals. | the toml key spelling kinds, bare basic or literal key |
| `TomlKeyValue` | Class | A `key = value` expression. The span starts at the first character of the line's leading whitespace and ends after the terminating newline (or at EOF); multi-line values extend it. `comment` holds the decoded trailing comment (without `#`, one leading space stripped) when present. | span and trailing comment for one assignment |
| `TomlLexErrorCode` | Variable + TypeAlias | The union of all lexer-stage error code string literals. | the union of toml lexer-stage error codes, tokenizing failure |
| `TomlLocalDate` | Class | A TOML local date: `year`-`month`-`day` with no time-of-day or offset, validated against the real Gregorian calendar. | no time or offset, validated calendar date |
| `TomlLocalDateTime` | Class | A TOML local date-time: a `TomlLocalDate` and a `TomlLocalTime` combined, with no offset. | no offset, combined date and time |
| `TomlLocalTime` | Class | A TOML local time: `hour`:`minute`:`second`[.`nanosecond`] with no date or offset. `second` tolerates the RFC 3339 leap second (0-60). | no date or offset, tolerates rfc 3339 leap second |
| `TomlModificationError` | Class | Raised when `TomlFormat.modify` cannot resolve the requested path against the document's semantic view, when the insertion target refuses (an inline table or an implicitly created table), or when the replacement value cannot render as TOML. | `TomlOffsetDateTime` | Class | A TOML offset date-time: a `TomlLocalDateTime` plus `offsetMinutes` (-1439-1439). Parsing enforces `hh <= 23` / `mm <= 59` before construction; this class only bounds the combined minute count. | utc offset in minutes |
| `TomlParseError` | Class | Parse failure: the `TomlDiagnostic` entries describing why the document was rejected (first violation wins, so there is one today; the array shape matches `@effected/yaml`'s aggregate contract). | `TomlParseErrorCode` | Variable + TypeAlias | The union of all parser-stage error code string literals. | the union of toml parser-stage error codes, grammar violation while parsing |
| `TomlPath` | TypeAlias | An ordered sequence of `TomlSegment` values describing a location within a TOML document's semantic tree. | |
| `TomlRange` | Class | A range within a TOML document, expressed as a zero-based character `offset` and a `length` in UTF-16 code units. | `TomlRangeLike` | TypeAlias | A range accepted at the `format`/`formatToString` call sites: either a `TomlRange` instance or a plain `{ offset, length }` literal (the two are structurally interchangeable — only `offset`/`length` are read). | |
| `TomlSegment` | TypeAlias | A single path segment: a `string` for table keys or a `number` for array and array-of-tables indices. | |
| `TomlSemanticErrorCode` | Variable + TypeAlias | The union of all semantic-stage error code string literals. | the union of toml semantic-stage error codes, duplicate key or table conflict |
| `TomlString` | Class | A string value node. `value` is the decoded text; the raw spelling lives in the source span. | decoded text plus raw source spelling |
| `TomlStringStyle` | Variable + TypeAlias | The union of all string-style literals. | the toml string quoting styles, basic literal multiline-basic or multiline-literal |

| `TomlStringifyErrorCode` | Variable + TypeAlias | The union of all stringifier-stage error code string literals. | the union of toml stringifier-stage error codes |
| `TomlStringifyOptions` | Class | Options controlling stringify behavior. The only knob is `newline` — omitted, it resolves to `"\n"`. | options controlling toml stringify newline output |
